nodes.label: Science and tech
nodes.question: What does regenerative farming aim to achieve?
nodes.answer: Regenerative farming aims to rebuild the foundations of farming by improving soil health, rather than merely sustaining it.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Life on land|Sustainable agriculture|Regenerative agriculture practices_qna_001
nodes.label: Strategy
nodes.question: How has regenerative farming emerged in recent decades?
nodes.answer: Regenerative farming has flourished in response to environmental and economic crises and the production-oriented farming and agro-industry.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Life on land|Sustainable agriculture|Regenerative agriculture practices_qna_002
nodes.label: Management
nodes.question: What does the paper aim to explore in relation to farming practices?
nodes.answer: The paper aims to explore the conditions for careful farming practices and how people negotiate and relate to practices of regenerative farming.
